name: Upgrade mark
summary: The Vivid Pink circle with a white crown, as the leading icon of a button that opens a paywall.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-upgrade-mark> — the same 16px mark <aha-paywall> draws as its anchor, for the icon slot of an <aha-button>. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render across frameworks.

spec.label: Size
spec.value: 16px circle, 12px crown, centred with the label

spec.label: Default
spec.value: Vivid Pink circle #E70E68, white crown (on a secondary button)

spec.label: Inverse
spec.value: white circle, pink crown (on a primary button, automatic)

props.name: inverse
props.desc: white circle, pink crown; set itself inside a primary <aha-button>, set it by hand elsewhere on a pink surface

whenToUse.when: a button that opens an <aha-paywall> because its feature is locked to a plan

opinion.note: Use this, never aha-icon system-crown-badge-fill, as the icon of a locked action: the bare glyph renders flat and sits off-centre.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render.

highlights: Slots into an aha-button as slot="icon": the paywall's pink circle and white crown, centred with the label.
Inside a primary button it inverts itself: white circle, pink crown.
Use it instead of aha-icon system-crown-badge-fill on any locked action.
